responsibility: This definition module declares a tiny file-output adapter for raw `ARRAY OF CHAR` strings in the gm2 library set. It belongs to the text I/O convenience layer above `FIO`, exporting `Write` to send a nul-terminated character array to a `File` and `WriteLn` to emit a line ending, so callers using fixed buffers can write textual data without converting to `DynamicStrings.String`.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the ARRAYOFCHAR pair: it only publishes the `ARRAY OF CHAR` writing interface, whereas `gcc/m2/gm2-libs/ARRAYOFCHAR.mod` contains the actual nul-terminated length scan and per-character `FIO` output logic.
